title: FinEval-KR: A Financial Domain Evaluation Framework for Large Language Models’ Knowledge and Reasoning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the tendency of the LLM-as-a-judge to assign higher scores to appealing text styles (e.g., clear structure, moderate length) despite reasoning errors. The authors evaluated and mitigated this by standardizing the output formats of all evaluated models before presenting them to the judge.

Conducting preliminary experiments to test whether the judging model (Qwen2.5-72B_Instruct) exhibited a self-bias tendency (i.e., a tendency to give higher scores to content it generated itself) during root cause localization and knowledge gap identification tasks.
